diagram_math_checks.data: Column leaf projection and upward transfer
diagram_math_checks.check: V_{sigma_j} is |sigma_j| by s_{sigma_j}; its adjoint maps F^{sigma_j} to F^{s_{sigma_j}}. E^V_{sigma_j} is s_{sigma_j} by s_sigma, so its adjoint maps the child coefficient to F^{s_sigma}. Both upward arrow directions match procedure step 1 (line 36). Contributions from both children are summed; the picture shows only one.
diagram_math_checks.justification: def-h2-nested-cluster-bases-and-interaction-lists, nested column-basis identity and storage convention; local procedure step 1.

diagram_math_checks.check: S_{tau,sigma} has r_tau rows and s_sigma columns, so the horizontal arrow takes z_sigma in F^{s_sigma} to an additive contribution in w_tau in F^{r_tau}. It is drawn only for an admissible block leaf, as stipulated in the Remarks. No commutativity or equality of whole coefficient vectors is asserted.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Local step 2 (line 37); supplier definition of admissible U_tau S_{tau,sigma} V_sigma^* blocks and interaction lists.

diagram_math_checks.data: Downward row transfer and leaf expansion
diagram_math_checks.check: E^U_{tau_i} is r_{tau_i} by r_tau and maps parent row coefficients to child coefficients; U_{tau_i} then maps F^{r_{tau_i}} to F^{tau_i}. The arrows therefore point downward. tau_i is explicitly depicted as a row leaf. Every incoming transfer and expansion is additive per step 3, not a claim that this branch gives the complete output.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Local step 3 (line 38); supplier nested row identity U_tau|_{tau_i}=U_{tau_i}E^U_{tau_i}.

diagram_math_checks.data: Dense near block and actual directed paths
diagram_math_checks.check: D_{eta,rho} has |eta| rows and |rho| columns, mapping x|_rho directly to an additive contribution to y|_eta, with no coefficient passes. eta and rho are separate labels so the diagram does not assert that the illustrated admissible pair is also near. Actual native image has 8 data nodes, the 5 directed main-chain edges and 1 separate near edge, all six arrowheads present; it has no cycles or endpoint rings requiring closure/open-point checks.
